title: [Technical Initiative] Migrate Old DBs to CloudSQL
notes:
**Owner:** Ross Allardice  Riggs Swanepoel
**Stage:** ✅ Tech initiative
**Teams:** DSCBE , PAY

**Problem / Context:**
With CloudSQL being the standard for database management at Takealot, most of our DBs reside there, but there are some old databases still residing on-premises that need to be migrated to CloudSQL.
CloudSQL is a service within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) that allows for easier database management, as well as having some trip wires in place that automate rebooting of hosts when needed that will greatly reduce the impact of incidents like this recent sev 1: SR-5363. Each database is also on its own instance which reduces the blast radius should an incident occur.
